about.title: Cerritos Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Cerritos residents shop, commute, and work near corridors like SR-91, South Street, Artesia Boulevard, and I-605, and defective products can turn an ordinary day into an emergency — a car part that fails at speed, a tool that malfunctions on the job, or a household item that ignites without warning. California generally applies strict liability to these cases, meaning you don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless, only that the product itself was flawed and that the flaw caused harm. That single fact matters a great deal in Los Angeles County, where products move through long supply chains involving makers, distributors, and retailers, any of whom might share responsibility. We evaluate the product, the injury, and the available evidence, all at no upfront cost to you.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: Because California often applies strict liability to defective products, you may not need to prove the manufacturer was negligent — only that the product was defective and caused your injury.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which matters in a city like Cerritos where products often pass through several hands before reaching a consumer.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters Early On
items.desc: We can advise you on keeping the defective item intact, since it's often the central piece of evidence in a strict liability claim.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California's strict liability rule generally focuses on whether the product itself was defective, not whether the company was negligent. We can review your situation and explain how this might apply to your claim.

items.question: What should I do with the product that injured me?
items.answer: Try to keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, without repairs or alterations, since it often serves as key evidence. Store it somewhere safe and avoid using it again until we have had a chance to review it.

items.question: Is this only for products bought in Cerritos?
items.answer: No. Whether you purchased or used the product along corridors like Artesia Boulevard, South Street, or elsewhere in Los Angeles County, what matters most is where the injury occurred and where you live. We can still help if you have a claim in this area.

items.question: Do you charge anything upfront?
items.answer: No. We handle product liability claims at no upfront cost, and we generally work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.
